methodologyNotes: Thirteen reloading presses spanning single-stage, turret, and progressive designs, verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer product pages (Dillon Precision, Hornady, RCBS, Lee Precision, Redding, Frankford Arsenal, Lyman) and corroborated where the manufacturer did not publish a figure (e.g. ram diameter, weight, or list price) against major retailers (MidwayUSA, Brownells, Titan Reloading, Graf & Sons, Powder Valley, Sportsman's Warehouse); fields left null (rather than guessed) where no source disclosed a value, most commonly rounds_per_hour for single-stage and turret presses (not throughput-rated by any manufacturer in this class) and ram_diameter_in / priceUsd for the three Dillon progressives and the RCBS Pro Chucker 7, none of which publish a ram-diameter spec, and for Hornady Lock-N-Load AP, RCBS Pro Chucker 7, and Lee Classic Turret, whose current single-unit list price could not be confirmed from a manufacturer or authorized-dealer page during this pass.

products.name: Dillon Precision RL550C Progressive Reloading Press
products.priceNote: Machine-only base price per Dillon-authorized dealers (Titan Reloading, Creedmoor Sports); dillonprecision.com itself sells the RL550C only as configured kits (with dies and one caliber conversion) starting near $750-$1,450.

specs.priming_system: on-press, automatic primer feed seated at station 1
specs.frame_material: aluminum alloy frame with steel toolhead and linkage
specs.shellplate_turret_compatibility: quick-change steel shellplate, caliber-specific; over 160 cartridges supported via Dillon conversion kits
specs.mounting_footprint: bench-mount, 4-bolt pattern; compatible with optional Dillon Strong Mount

products.provenance: Dillon's own RL550 product page and Graf & Sons/Wholesale Reloading Supplies listings confirm 4-station manual-indexing progressive operation (resize/deprime/prime, flare/powder, seat, crimp), standard 7/8-14 dies, and the well-documented 400-600 rounds/hour manual throughput. Dillon does not publish a numeric ram-diameter spec on any fetched page, so that field is null rather than estimated. Machine-only price ($590) taken from authorized dealers since Dillon's own site bundles the press with a conversion kit and dies by default.

products.name: Dillon Precision XL750 Progressive Reloading Press
products.priceNote: Dillon sells the XL750 only as a configured kit (caliber, casefeeder, handle, and accessory options all change the total); authorized-dealer machine-only prices observed ranged roughly $850-$1,560 depending on configuration, so no single figure is used rather than guess a base price.

specs.rounds_per_hour: 500-600 hand-cranked; up to 900 with optional electric case feeder
specs.priming_system: on-press, automatic primer feed with primer-low warning system
specs.frame_material: aluminum alloy frame with steel toolhead and linkage
specs.shellplate_turret_compatibility: quick-change steel shellplate, caliber-specific toolhead; supports .17 Hornet through belted magnum rifle and .32 ACP through .500 S&W handgun
specs.mounting_footprint: bench-mount, 4-bolt pattern; compatible with optional Dillon Strong Mount

products.provenance: Dillon's own XL750 page and corroborating retailer copy (Scheels, Creedmoor Sports, GunUniversity review) confirm 5 stations, auto-indexing, a separate crimp station, fail-safe powder system, 100-round primer magazine, and the 500-900 rounds/hour range depending on whether the optional electric case feeder is fitted. No manufacturer-published ram-diameter figure was located, so that field is null. Price left null: fetched retail figures ranged from ~$850 (base machine at some dealers) to $1,560+ (fully accessorized), with no single authoritative machine-only MSRP confirmed.

products.name: Dillon Precision Square Deal B Progressive Reloading Press
products.priceNote: Authorized-dealer price (benstoegerproshop.com) for the machine complete with one caliber conversion installed, which is Dillon's standard sales configuration for the SDB; dillonprecision.com's own listed range ($750-$2,033.98) reflects additional bundled dies/accessories.

specs.priming_system: on-press, automatic primer feed integrated at station 2
specs.shellplate_turret_compatibility: proprietary Dillon SDB toolhead/shellplate system, not compatible with standard 7/8-14 dies; pistol/straight-wall calibers .32 S&W Long through .45 Colt only
specs.mounting_footprint: compact bench-mount, machine height 18-1/2 in. from bench

products.provenance: Dillon's Square Deal B page and the ManualsLib-hosted assembly/user manual confirm the 4-station auto-indexing layout (resize/deprime, prime/powder/flare, seat, crimp), the proprietary non-7/8-14 toolhead unique to this model, 300-500 rounds/hour typical rate, +/-0.10 gr powder measure accuracy, and 18-1/2 in. bench height. No manufacturer ram-diameter figure was located (not applicable in the same way as standard-die presses given the proprietary toolhead), so it is left null.

products.priceNote: Manufacturer list price per Powder Valley Outdoors/OpticsPlanet listings (commonly discounted to roughly $270-282 at retail).

products.name: RCBS Rock Chucker Supreme Single Stage Reloading Press
products.priceNote: MSRP for the standalone press per RCBS-authorized retailers (Sportsman's Warehouse, GunCritic); shop.rcbs.com markets it primarily bundled in the $475.56 Rock Chucker Supreme Master Reloading Kit.

specs.shellplate_turret_compatibility: standard 7/8-14 threaded dies, 4.25 in. loading window for magnum-length cartridges
